newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Megionneftegaz plans ADR in Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Megionneftegaz plans ADR in Q1 1997.

text.p: Russian oil company AOOT Megionneftegaz intends to issue its planned American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in the first quarter of this year, a senior official at the company's financial consultant Megatrastoil said on Tuesday.
Megatrastoil Deputy Chief Executive Alexei Pechonkin told Reuters the ADRs would be level-one, and thus not raise any new capital or involve any new issues of shares.
"A new issue of shares is not planned," he said.
The depositary bank will be The Bank of New York, which has acted for most Russian ADR programmes.
Megionneftegaz is the main operating unit of Russian-Belarussian joint venture Slavneft, one of a dozen vertically integrated oil groups set up in Russia in the last few years.
